\section{Adaptive Methods}\label{sec:adaptive}

Since instance-level selection fails (\S\ref{sec:selection_gap}), we present approaches that extract value from multi-sample generation beyond single-signal sample ranking.
Table~\ref{tab:method_summary} summarizes all 9 method categories evaluated; only cross-model ensembles yield a positive result, though on a single dataset.

\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\small
\caption{Summary of 9 method categories tested (including MV baseline, LP selection, and cross-model ensemble beyond the seven verification methods in \S\ref{sec:mechanistic}--\S\ref{sec:adaptive}). $\Delta$F1 vs.\ greedy; dataset in parentheses. Full coverage in Appendix~\ref{app:method_coverage}.}
\label{tab:method_summary}
\resizebox{\columnwidth}{!}{%
\begin{tabular}{@{}llrl@{}}
\toprule
Category & Method & $\Delta$F1 / metric & § \\
\midrule
Freq.\ voting & MV & baseline & \ref{sec:prescriptive} \\
LP selection & Best-of-$N$ (LP) & $+1.39$\,pp (FN)$^\dagger$ & \ref{sec:selection_gap} \\
Self-verif.\ (prompt) & ESJ & AUROC $0.51$ & \ref{sec:mechanistic} \\
Multi-round refine. & MRSC & $-3.1$\,pp (FN) & \ref{sec:mechanistic} \\
Latent aggregation & LSC & $-3.5$\,pp (FN) & \ref{sec:mechanistic} \\
Adaptive gating & DALS & $+0.71$\,pp (SciERC)$^\ddagger$ & App.~\ref{app:dals} \\
Supervised verifier & LGB & $+0.30$\,pp (OOF) & \ref{sec:verifier} \\
Sup.\ combination & LR/MLP/RF & $-0.4$ to $-3.1$\,pp & App.~\ref{app:supervised_combination} \\
Cross-model & Qwen$+$LLaMA & $\mathbf{+0.42}$\,pp (FN) & \ref{sec:cross_model} \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}}
{\footnotesize $^\dagger$Few-NERD only; SciERC $+0.2$\,pp ($p{=}0.29$). $^\ddagger$Seed-sensitive ($\sigma{=}0.48$\,pp).}
\end{table}

\subsection{Cross-Model Self-Consistency}\label{sec:cross_model}

Mixing samples from architecturally distinct models can partially bypass within-model degeneracy.
Combining 4 samples each from Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B (Few-NERD) yields $+0.42$\,pp over pure LLaMA ($p{<}0.001$, CI $[0.27, 0.58]$; $N{=}8$ total).
This observation is preliminary (single dataset, $n{=}4{+}4$ samples); cross-dataset validation is needed before drawing general conclusions.

\subsection{Trained Verifiers: High Discrimination, Low Transfer}\label{sec:verifier}

A LightGBM entity-level classifier (5 features: agreement count, LP, VC, SJ, FK) achieves AUC${=}0.923{\pm}0.002$ under out-of-fold evaluation, yet translates to only $+0.30$\,pp overall ($+1.28$ SciERC, $+0.02$ Few-NERD): frequency-based construction already captures most verifier signal.
Cross-dataset transfer is negative ($-0.76$ to $-1.02$\,pp on Few-NERD; Appendix~\ref{app:verifier_transfer}), confirming dataset-specific feature mappings.
Even near-perfect entity classification cannot close the gap, indicating a structural bottleneck.

SSH to autodl-5090 and autodl-5090-c. Two tasks:

**Task 1 (HIGH PRIORITY): FewNERD Freeform MV/LP/Degeneracy Recompute**

Server: autodl-5090
Data: /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/output/fewnerd_freeform_n8_seed42/samples.jsonl

Compute the same metrics as the CoNLL freeform Table 33:
- MV strict F1 (θ=0.5 majority vote across 8 samples)
- LP-best F1 (sample with highest mean_logprob)
- Degeneracy rate (fraction where all 8 samples identical entity sets)
- Greedy F1 (first sample)

Also get the CONSTRAINED FewNERD reference values for comparison. The MF4 seed=42 constrained results are:
- greedy_f1 = 0.7911, mv_strict_f1 = 0.7585, mv_delta = -3.27pp, lp_f1 = 0.7918, degen = 9.1%
(These are from the 3-seed MV unified recompute, already in registry)

Use or adapt the recompute script from the FewNERD 3-seed MV recompute. Check:
```bash
find /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/ -name "recompute_mv*.py" -o -name "*mv_recompute*" 2>/dev/null
find /tmp/ -name "recompute*" 2>/dev/null
```

Output Table 33 format:
```
FewNERD N=8 T=1.0 seed=42:
                    Constrained    Free-form     Δ
greedy_f1              0.7911       X.XXXX      X.XX pp
mv_strict_f1           0.7585       X.XXXX      X.XX pp
mv_Δ (pp)               -3.27        X.XX       X.XX pp
lp_f1                  0.7918       X.XXXX      X.XX pp
lp_Δ (pp)               +0.07        X.XX       X.XX pp
degeneracy_rate          9.1%        XX.X%       X.X pp
```

**Task 2: PT N=16 Crash Diagnosis**

Server: autodl-5090-c
exp_fewnerd_pretrained_n16_s42 crashed with UnicodeEncodeError in sampling.py:675 during save_sampled_results().

```bash
wc -l /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/output/fewnerd_pretrained_n16_seed42/samples.jsonl

```

Step 2: Check the error in code
```bash
grep -n "save_sampled_results\|def save_sampled" /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/code/sampling.py | head -5
sed -n '670,685p' /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/code/sampling.py
```

The fix is likely: add `errors='replace'` or `errors='surrogateescape'` to the file open() call, or filter out surrogate characters before writing.

Step 3: Fix the code and prepare for rerun
- Fix the UnicodeEncodeError in sampling.py
- Check if cuda:1 on 5090-c is now free
- Do NOT resubmit yet — just fix the code and report the fix. Director will decide whether to rerun.

Report all findings.
